conclusions.keyFailureMode: An event can mechanically reopen a company revenue channel while simultaneously worsening the broader market opportunity set or creating offsetting system effects. IPO restart increased underwriting opportunity but also equity supply/liquidity pressure; quarterly revenue latency was not the only missing issue.
conclusions.comparisonTo2014: 2014 Stock Connect shadow succeeded, but 2013 IPO restart failed. The difference cannot be resolved by the existing route definition without post-outcome overfitting.
conclusions.productionDecision: Do not adopt the market-structure route into the production Skill.
conclusions.nextResearchQuestion: Test whether explicit two-sided system-incidence analysis (direct company benefit versus market/liquidity/supply offset) improves discrimination on a fresh untouched window before any adoption.
